scope: Public upstream acquisition links, not hosted TB bundles and not a claim of completed corpus assembly

counting.normalization: Unicode regex with no underscore tokens; not model/BPE tokens

selection.algorithm: Walk source_order and listed file/row order; normalize complete source documents, deduplicate counted title+text by SHA256 (first occurrence wins), retain native ID aliases/gold mappings; stop BEFORE the first whole document would exceed the tier token budget. Do not skip ahead to pad the budget. Report actual retained counts and any shortfall.
selection.nesting: One deterministic source stream; tier cuts retain earlier selected documents. Official suite pools are separate, full native populations and unchanged qrels/exclusions.
selection.safety: No truncation, invented text, repeated padding, or omitted/missing gold silently relabeled irrelevant. Fail if selected files exhaust before target; measured corpus hashes/counts are produced by assembly, not by this link manifest.

source_extractors.BRIGHT: Parquet: doc id/content; examples carry queries, gold_ids and excluded_ids. AoPS/theoremqa_questions share identical corpus bytes; preserve both native task mappings.
source_extractors.BEIR: Parquet corpus/title/text and native IDs; queries plus pinned test.tsv qrels. Keep native empty documents in official lanes.
source_extractors.MuSiQue: Answerable dev/train JSONL: paragraph contexts, original titles/text and supporting-paragraph relationships. Preserve example split and paragraph occurrences/aliases.
source_extractors.MultiHopRAG: corpus.json documents and MultiHopRAG.json queries/evidence; use the official field mapping, never chunk without retaining native evidence aliases.
source_extractors.FineWebEdu: Parquet text plus native id and provenance; empty title. Files are an ordered reserve; fetch/read only as needed, never the whole sample automatically.
